Wireframe skill test fixture

Loads amvcp-designmd.js then amvcp-wireframe.js as browser globals. window.__wfManualInit is set so the test drives init() deterministically AFTER the engine has applied the embedded DESIGN.md tokens. The DESIGN.md uses a vivid magenta accent (#cc4488) so desaturation is observable: at fidelity wireframe every kit block paints grey, even though --vc-color-accent is bright magenta.
